core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Ghaysaa corresponds to the Arabic form غيثة (Arabic root غ ي ث (gh-y-th); غيثة (Ghaytha)). Its core sense is rain, succour, relief. Ghaysaa corresponds to غيثة (Ghaytha), the feminine of غيث (Ghayth) 'rain, succour'. The source gloss 'seeking refuge' is close to the 'succour/rescue' sense of the root and is retained in that sense.

urdu.name: غیثہ
urdu.long_meaning: Ghaysaa (غیثہ) عربی زبان سے ماخوذ نام ہے۔ اس کا بنیادی مفہوم بارش، امداد ہے۔ یہ نام مسلم معاشروں میں رکھا جاتا ہے اور اس کے مفاہیم سیاق و سباق کے مطابق استعمال ہوتے ہیں۔

persian.name: غيثه

faq.q: What is the origin of Ghaysaa?
faq.a: Ghaysaa is associated with Arabic. Ghaysaa corresponds to غيثة (Ghaytha), the feminine of غيث (Ghayth) 'rain, succour'. The source gloss 'seeking refuge' is close to the 'succour/rescue' sense of the root and is retained in that sense.
Yes — the underlying form غيثة is Arabic.
Ghaysaa can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.

faq.q: What does Ghaysaa mean in Urdu?
faq.a: In Urdu, Ghaysaa is rendered غیثہ and carries the sense بارش، امداد.

faq.q: What does Ghaysaa mean in Persian?
faq.a: In Persian, Ghaysaa is rendered غيثه and carries the sense باران، فریادرسی.
A romanized syllable approximation is ghay-saa. No IPA transcription is asserted because a verified phonetic transcription was not available.

faq.q: What are the variants of Ghaysaa?
faq.a: Romanization variants include Ghaysaa, ghaysa, ghaysaa. Script forms are غيثة, غيثه, غیثہ, ग़ैसा.

faq.q: Is Ghaysaa a boy's or girl's name?
faq.a: Documented usage records this form as female. Gender is not inferred from the meaning of the word, and actual use may vary between communities.
